column2: How do you even win a comment war online?
It's less about winning, and more about\nnot losing, I think.
The internet is back at it again.
At this point, the world is 50.78% anger,\n44.2% suffering, and 4.493% Yunyun.
Looks like the devil didn't rise to earth after all!
It’s a microchip you put inside your body.
Even if cats turn out to be evil, no way I’d\nbe able to resist giving them pets!
Yeah, you can’t help but want to scritch the cuties!
Cats are mysterious. Something that cute\nhas to be a gift from the cosmos!
Those ears... They've held the secrets to pulling the heart strings of all weaboos since the dawn of time...
My Qtie-pie could never lose motivation when\nshe's in the DOKI DOKI zone!
Nothing can stand between me and my love of Denpa!
If parallel worlds were real, which one would\nyou wanna go to, Qtie?
There's gotta be at least one where Mommy really\nloves me? Right?
If the whole world rebooted five minutes ago,\ndoes that mean the luv we feel isn't real?!
It doesn't matter if our memories are real or\nplanted! LUV IS LUV! It changes nothing!
Didn't all birds descend from dinosaurs?
For real? Is this about to turn into a 'which\ncame first, the dinosaur or the chicken' situation?
They really put the oops in OOPSArt.
Do you think they forgot about it, like dropping\na quarter or something?
Some kinda virus has made the news!\nBe careful, Qtie!!
Don't worry, I'd have to go outside to catch it.
It was a real cloud too, even by meteorological\nstandards.
I've heard that the paranormal like to gather\nin and near water! Like Nessie!
One French scientist said that water has memory of all the places it's been. The theory got pretty popular.
If it's so hot that sweat clouds are forming,\nwhy even go to the event?
You’re basically fully consisted from instant\nmeals and energy drinks, aren’t you Qtie?
Oh my GAWD! If this is true, I never have to\ncook again! Processed food 4 EVER!
What’s your favorite instant meal Qtie?
No wayz... Could the reason I can talk to Yunyun\nbe the magic of instant meals?!
Nooo! That’s thanks to our mutual DENPA LUV!
The magical girl personas of all your apps, duh.
I wonder how many personal blogs and stuff have\nbeen lost to time.
The last good thing to come out of the internet tbh.\nAll those HTML files are just static now.
Apparently those magical girl internet fairies\nare gym rats!
Huh. I wonder if their abs look like bar codes.
Dunno who thought of that one,\nbut it's pretty funny.
Looks like Agent Ibis isn't woke about animal cruelty.
Proof that laws won't change anything.\nThere's always a loophole.
Lots of app icons are birds, aren't they?
That really pushy language app icon is a bird too,\nisn't it?
IDC why you're doing it. All scalpers should\nbe ANNIHILATED!
You sound like an Execution Angel, Qtie!
I've been burned TOO many times by scalpers to GAF!
Hell hath no fury like an otaku scorned...
It looks like these scalpers think they’re the good guys! They're saying it's a necessary evil for the greater good!
The ends justify the means people are such hopeless l0zers.
It stands for games, anime, figures, and idols. It's some big, influential, monopoly type company.
It's true some jingles get stuck in your head something fierce. Like you can still hear them echoing.
Aha! They're trying to burn themselves into your\nbrain, like those tropes you can see from a mile away!
You mean like, the pink haired MC always being hot headed, or the blue haired MC always being doomed romantically?
And purple hair totally means they're a demon!
Did they unlock some kind of special achievement or what?
It's true! The more people there are, the more advanced we get!
It's a chicken and the egg sitch. You could also say innovation makes it easier to increase the population.
Apparently, 10 million people from now we'll be so leveled up we'll move to SPACE!
We'd have no choice at that point. The Earth is too small.
Neato. If the needles really are silver,\nno wonder vamps would avoid them.
Fantasy, drama, comedy. Doesn't matter WHAT genre\nit is! Make your characters vampires on top of that\nand BOOM, smash hit.
A vampire with cat ears is pretty hard to\nimagine, Qtie.
WAIT! If I became a vampire, that would be the\nperfect excuse to be a shut-in and really catch up\non all my gaming and anime!
You'd still have to go outside to find blood to drink.
Do you remember your first love, Qtie?
You’re my first and only, Yunyun!
Mommy likes characters who are villain coded,\nlike demon princesses and stuff too.
Heehee! I'm a villain, and a demon! A cute one tho!
I saw this in a PC game once. Apparently there was a religion that said all misfortune originates from the curse on a first love.
Qtie's first love was Yunyun, right? Do you feel cursed?
DUH!!!! This one is so true. They’ve done studies about it, just look at da results!!
Yup, my beloved moe songs are on repeat erryday!
Opening yourself to the word of moe in\nDenpa songs rlly makes you feel purified.
No-life gamers would practice their RTA, even in hell.
That’s like... Sisyphus' stone... Aren't games supposed to be fun?
What kinda games do you like to play, Qtie?
Cutesy games, rhythm games, parry combat games, stuff like that. Smashing that button at juuust the right moment is such a rush.
Bro really said "I am a pro-gamer dominating the world with my ultimate RTA records after endless lifetimes of reincarnation spent honing my skills". I'd say get a life, but...
It’s like straight out of a light novel,\nor maybe a webtoon!
The phrase “late-night” gives it that\nsecretive, underground feel.
Having to sneak around and turn on the TV\nwithout Mommy noticing is pretty doki doki inducing.
Late-night anime is demon worship?\nIf the characters were demons, maybe.
Demons can make people delulu, waste their lives, and are nothing but fantasy. Pretty similar to anime actually!
There's tons of theories that humans came from space, y'know. People love their aliens and their cyberpunky RPGs.
You think the Creator really put us in time out?
You don't see marriage much in the world of fiction. That's left up to your imagination once the credits roll.
That's so true. Hardly any stories have their romantic interests canonically get married. It's only in the fan made content.
If marriage is a kind of punishment, I bet you can't get out of it easy. Divorce must be tough to pull off.
Vows are supposed to say til' death do you part.\nNot paperwork.
Platonic zombies? I don't get it, but parents\nmust be pretty strong carrying on without a soul\nof their own.
You really do get molded by your parents. From your genetics, to your personality, to your morals.
I guess as a parent, you're ready to sacrifice everything you are for your kid. They're that precious.
Qtie, have you been outside recently?
LOL. No. And hell hasn’t frozen over either.
Then ur safe! This conspiracy can't effect a\nnight owl hikikomori like you!
Looks like more and more people are living that\nnight owl life.
Come to the dark side. We have cookies...
Dunno. I do remember my shoes disappearing after\ngym class a lot in middle school.
Is that cosplay? Isn't that just a costume?
It doesn't matter how much they try to fake it. They can't cosplay the emotional damage done to your soul from being bullied.
Was there ever someone in school you hated\nfor not stepping in to help you, Qtie?
I was too busy hating myself.
Never getting to know how a story ends is the\nworst feeling.
If you could find out the true ending to any piece\nof canceled media, which would it be?!
Not just manga? There's tons of anime that never got more than thirteen episodes, or light novels that never got their third issue. Too many to choose from tbh.
What if "Execution Angel † Guiltina" makes a\ncomeback, Qtie?!
As much as I'd die to see new Yunyun content, it's better to let a show have a good ending rather than drag it out until it's garbo.
I don't get it. What's AND YOU?
It's like the audience recognition at the very\nend of whatever credits.
Are you the type to watch the end credits, Qtie?
Duh! It's the perfect way to sit in the afterglow\nof what you just watched.
End credits for games are always super long, huh!
Games are so multimedia, and you have to make\na whole world from scratch. Seems tough, ngl.
How come you never do live streams, Qtie?
I hate humans, and society. A hikikomori like me\ncould never put myself out there like that. Yikes.
Have you ever thought about collecting money\nfrom all those Denpa antenna conspirators, Qtie?
I'm not in it for the money. I'm in it to\nspread that Yunyun luv.
Streamers and let's players are super popular\nthese days.
I guess. If it's not Yunyun, it's just a bunch\nof hooey too me.
Do you think the summers are getting hotter, Qtie?
Huh? I dunno. Mommy has deffo gotten mad\nabout the electric bill being more expensive, tho.
What do you associate summers with, Qtie?
Is human memory that bad? Qtie, what do you\nremember from last summer?
I can't even remember what I did last week.\nLast summer? Yeesh.
Oh yeah. I never signed a contract with you\n, even tho ur a demon, Yunyun. Is that chill?
You didn't need to! We're connected through Denpa. In continuing to talk to me, you've already agreed to the terms and conditions!
All fictional beings survive as long as someone\nis around to remember them. Demons included!
I think they call it Thanatophobia? The thought of suddenly blipping out of existence one day is pretty spooky.
Yunyun will keep your soul company, even in the\nafterlife. You'll never be alone Qtie-pie. Never.
Oh! I have a Wiki profile too, don't I?
Huehue. I want you!\nTo join the Yunyun stan army.
I luuuuuv going down a Wiki rabbit hole!
The lost art of internet surfing. Ah.\nThose were the days.
The Caligula effect! Anytime a word is censored,\nyou can't help but be more curious what it is!
Careful with searching those censored words. The government guy reading your stuff could end up sending you some crazy ads.
I guess if being born under certain stars can\nmake a difference, so can satellites!
Checks out. Maybe the satellites are why everyone’s\ninternet addicted these days.
If astrology is legit, than your whole destiny\ncould change cuz of some satellite up in space!
Could a satellite be to blame for why my life\nsuxx so bad?!
And if the satellite you were born under was broken,\nyou’d be in big trouble!
Welp. Sounds like at least one satellite is\nseriously broken.
You have lots of figures in your\nroom, don’t you Qtie?
I’m usually good with 2D but... They’re so otaku!\nAnd giving form to something you love is nice.
The day I first got my hands on a Yunyun figure,\nI felt myself get closer to otaku enlightenment.
With or without a figure, if you feel that\nYUNYUN LUV, you’re an indoctrinated otaku!
Wait, did I accidentally perform some spirit ritual with my figures?! Is that how I’m talking with Yunyun?
I’m not a spirit, I’m a demon! Plus, Qtie and I\nare connected by the miracle of Denpa, nothing else!
If stars aren't real, that totally means the moon\nlanding was fake too!
Honestly, that's a relief. Space is freaky.\nAt least now we don't have to worry about\nan alien invasion.
If the sky is a planetarium, I want 24/7\nshooting stars!!
All REAL otakus know Morse code! Right?
I don't wanna be mainstream, but I don't wanna be too niche either. I like having people around that get it.
Qtie, what’s even the point of a Vtuber?\nThere’s already tons of cute, real people!
Eh, I like them, but none are as cute as you, Yunyun. Vtubers are just real people wrapped in a 2D package.
So many new video streaming platforms\nthese days, huh!
Too many for my brain to handle...\nI miss Vine.
People are hooked on the word ‘reincarnation’\nthese days.
eUuUGUgH. Even hearing the word Monday\ngives me heartburn.
Not even God is safe from the Monday Blues.
Hikikomori neets have no day off. We’re\nalways suffering, on a bed of nails and guilt...
Whoa Qtie! You’re doing your best, and that’s\nfive stars in my book!
If we get Mondays off thanks to these secret\nsociety guys, I’m sure everyone would be hype!
Right!! Erm... hey...\nWhat day of the week is it anyway?
Millionaires are NEETs? I have heard that the\nreally real rich people take their money\nand go off grid.
Could it be... Qtie are you secretly RICH?
LMFAO. As if. I'm a NEET of a more standard variety.
You're not standard! You're Yunyun's limited\nedition, SSR, five star, one and only Qtie-pie!
NEETs are Nobles of Elegant Eternal Time...?
When Daddy was still around we had cable TV.\nWe used to binge anime together all the time.
Watching a marathon was almost as intense\nas running one!!
I've made some international friends online\ncuz we bonded over Yunyun!
Denpa without borders! That's so awesomesauce!
It hurts when they lock your favorite content\nbehind a paywall.
For realz. Doesn't matter if it's anime, manga, or light novels. It should all be liberated to the people!1!!
Does Qtie have a digital wallet too?
Yeah, I've got one called BITMOEE. I use it for\nin-game micro-transactions.
What happens when Qtie wants to do some\nretail therapy?
I usually have some pocket money or something\nleft from the holidays to use.
Otakus are hella contributors to the economy!
Huh. I guess I do contribute to society. In that\none, single way.
Come to think of it, "Execution Angel † Guiltina"\nis a boy show. How come you like it, Qtie?
Bc of Yunyun's amazing MOE! And moe is\ngenderless! Moe transcends sexuality! Moe is for ALL!
If Mommy and Daddy had been able to customize\ntheir kid, I prolly would've never been born.
Then it's a MIRACLE you were! My five-star Qtie-pie!
No way I'm ever going to be a parent. I can't\neven imagine it.
You gotta do you, Qtie! As long as what you do makes\nyou happy, I'm happy!
Do you play gacha games, Qtie?
Nah, but if a Yunyun themed one got released I probably would. My wallet would be empty, but Yunyun luv is worth it all!
Denpa songs, gacha games, AMVs...\nThere's lots of addicting stuff on the web.
My drug of choice is Yunyun's demonically\nkawaii voice!
What's so bad about brainwashing anywayz? Didn't that book with the mouse prove that we're happier the dumber we are?
Elegant domination and subordination is a\ngive and take! Classic Denpa nonsense.
This one’s funny, but old as conspiracy theories go.\nI’ve seen people say Finland isn’t real, either.
Srsly?!\nLot’s of cogito ergo sum types online I see.
There are lots of animals that don’t seem real.\nLike, that one beaver that screamed like a dude!
I’m pretty sure that beaver only exists\nin edited audio form, Qtie.
Otakus suuuuck at making snappy comebacks tho.
They don't make comebacks so much as they\nfall back! Retreat! Retreat!
I'm not a sadist or a masochist! I'm a YUNYUNist!
Eheehee! Then Yunyun is a QTIEist!
Does that mean if I talk like Yunyun, I'll be\njust as angelically kawaii?!
This is getting creepy. Aren't you freaked, Qtie?
Who me? I used to spend 20 plus hours a DAY\nreading creepypastas on the net. This is cheese.
It's pretty cringe now, but I used to be so into\nthe dark, I'd even try and summon demons and stuff.
Ugh. Even as a naive demon worshiper, ur SUCH a QT!
I've heard there are tons of monsters that only\nappear if you say their name!
I got so obsessed with Yunyun, she appeared...\nDoes that mean I actually summoned a demon?!
Now I've seen it all. If the world can be made out of pasta, I should start the official Yunyun religion.
A world where a PC game character can become\nGod has seriously got some issues!
Oooh, I heard the source code for "Execution\nAngel † Guiltina" was some serious spaghetti!
Who cares? As long as it's playable, tbh.
Seeing pics from space or reading astronaut journal entries gives me the shivers. The universe is frickin’ amazing.
The universe would be nothing without\nyou in it, Qtie!
With this way of thinking, even Yunyun turns\ninto some kind of dangerous thing.
Yup! 100% of people who have ever known me\nhave eventually died!
Qtie, do you drink alcohol at all?
Heh. Who needs to drink when I can get dЯunk off YUNYUN!
It’s all about eating, drinking, doing whatever ya want! The healthiest lifestyle is one with no stress.
All I want is you, Yunyun.
Birds are pretty creepy when they just perch on\npower lines like that.
True... It doesn't happen too often, but when\nit does? Yikes.
Mommy has been pissed that the electric bill\nis so expensive recently. It's cuz of bird drones?
Ohoho! Nothing like an adventure to the unknown to get you all psyched up. Reminds me of the first time I logged on to the internet.
Doesn’t it make you just wanna hold up your spork?!
What's your internet origin story, Qtie?
Daddy's computer had some games on it that I liked. Before I knew it, I was neck deep in the otaku quicksand.
Stories set in the Arctic always end with some freaky bad-news aliens showing up. Man I'm glad I'm a hikikomori sometimes.
Yup! The scariest things Qtie has to worry about\nare your Denpa delusions!
Why would anyone make an earthquake happen\non purpose?
Internet trolls have always liked to say earthquakes are caused by some underground experiments or whatever.
OMG Qtie! If this is true, one of your antennas\njust made the world a better place!
I'd rather he put his efforts into bringing back\nthe prime time anime slot on TV, but OK.
When I think late-night anime sponsors, I think\nmusic labels and as seen on TV stuff.
Religion is all about idol worship.\nGuess there's a lot in common with fandom.
With all this new tech, you never know when or how\nBig Bro is watching you.
Oh I know! The best way to make sure you're never under surveillance is to never leave the house! Hikikomori supremacy!
